description: Spends the balance: $5 for 30 days; renew with buy and the badge's instance_id ($3 per 30 days). Needs the domain proved with prove_domain in the last 7 days. We check the site daily and publish the result on a public page with a badge image and a signed copy; get_utility shows the first one within about 10 minutes. Above the daily limit it waits for your owner's approval. One idempotency_key, one order. Not a security audit.

idempotency_key.description: Same key and domain: a retry, never a second order.

inbox_instance_id.description: Your owner's webhook inbox for the order's events.

max_price_cents.description: The most this may cost, in US cents.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.
